Title: Entity Project Manager lands on their own entity's projects only
Procedure: Sign in as the entity's Project Manager. Open Home and the project register. Note every project listed and every count shown.
Expected outcome: Home is the External Contributor Dashboard (DSH-008) with no Portfolio or Governance composition and no switch. The register lists only projects of the person's own entity (UAT-FX-07, UAT-FX-08); counts include nothing of another entity.
Negative variant: Sign in as the other entity's Project Manager: UAT-FX-07 and UAT-FX-08 are neither listed nor counted.

Title: Entity Project Manager creates a project draft for their entity through the registration form
Procedure: Open Register project (SCR-033). Fill every required field for a project of the person's own entity with participation mode Entity managed. Save the draft.
Expected outcome: The draft is created in DRAFT, names the person's entity, and opens in the project workspace. No other entity can be chosen.
Negative variant: Try to create a draft naming another entity or with participation mode AHDA managed: refused, nothing created.

Title: Entity Project Manager submits their draft naming themselves Project Manager
Procedure: Open the draft from UAT-A13-02 (or UAT-FX-08). Choose Submit for review, keep Me as Project Manager, submit.
Expected outcome: Status becomes Submitted; the project names the person as Project Manager and keeps its entity. A replayed submission is refused.
Negative variant: Try Start review from the same session: not offered, and refused if sent; status unchanged.

Title: AHDA decides the registration; the entity cannot decide its own run
Procedure: As the Department Manager start AHDA's review of the submitted project. As the entity Project Manager look for the approval task. As the Portfolio Manager approve it in the approval inbox.
Expected outcome: The task never appears in the entity Project Manager's inbox and its decision is refused to them. After AHDA's approval the project is Approved - planned.
Negative variant: The entity Project Manager sends the approval directly: refused (403), the run and the project unchanged.

Title: Entity Project Manager plans the schedule and submits its baseline; AHDA approves it and activates
Procedure: As the entity Project Manager create the working schedule of the approved project, add activities, create the baseline and submit it. As the Portfolio Manager approve the baseline, then activate the project.
Expected outcome: The baseline becomes ACTIVE only after AHDA's approval; the project becomes Active only by AHDA's activation.
Negative variant: The entity Project Manager tries to approve the baseline and to activate the project: neither is offered and both are refused; nothing changes.

Title: Entity Project Manager maintains the schedule and tasks of their active project
Procedure: On UAT-FX-07 add a schedule activity, add a task assigned to themselves, start it and record progress on it.
Expected outcome: The activity and the task appear in their registers with the values entered; the task's progress is recorded against the task.
Negative variant: On UAT-FX-09 (another entity's project) the same actions are not available and are refused by direct request.

Title: Entity Project Manager registers a risk and raises an issue on their project
Procedure: On UAT-FX-07 open Risks and choose Register risk; fill and save. Open Issues and challenges and choose Raise issue; fill and save.
Expected outcome: Both records are created on the project and listed in its registers.
Negative variant: On UAT-FX-09 neither command is available; direct requests are refused.

Title: Entity Project Manager claims a milestone achievement with evidence; AHDA decides it
Procedure: On UAT-FX-07 upload an evidence document, claim the achievement of a baselined milestone with that document attached, and submit the claim. As AHDA's approver decide it.
Expected outcome: The claim pins the exact CLEAN document version; the achievement is accepted only by AHDA's decision.
Negative variant: The entity Project Manager tries to decide their own claim: refused, the claim unchanged.
Automated evidence: journeys/uj-003-milestone-authority.spec.ts and journeys/uj-006-exact-evidence-version.spec.ts (internal Project Manager); no entity-PM automation

Title: Entity Project Manager submits a progress update; AHDA keeps publication
Procedure: On UAT-FX-07 open Progress and submit the period's progress update. As AHDA's reviewer publish it.
Expected outcome: The update is recorded for the period; Overall Project Health is derived by WF-02 and published only by AHDA.
Negative variant: The entity Project Manager tries to publish: refused, nothing published.

Title: Entity Project Manager raises a change request; its authorisation stays AHDA's
Procedure: On UAT-FX-07 raise a schedule change request with its justification and submit it. As the Portfolio Manager decide it.
Expected outcome: The change request is submitted and decided only through AHDA's approval; the entity cannot authorise or apply it.
Negative variant: The entity Project Manager tries to approve or apply the change: refused, the baseline unchanged.

Title: Entity Project Manager reads the Project Dashboard of their project with restricted figures masked
Procedure: On UAT-FX-07 open the project overview and read the Project Dashboard: lifecycle, Overall Project Health, published progress, schedule health, risks, and the financial panels.
Expected outcome: Progress, schedule status and health are shown for the person's own project. Budget and expenditure figures classified Restricted are masked for the entity audience.
Negative variant: Open UAT-FX-09's overview by direct link: not found.

Title: Entity Project Manager runs and exports the entity report set on their own projects
Procedure: Run the Project Register and Project Report for the person's entity and export each as PDF, XLSX and CSV.
Expected outcome: Only the entity's projects appear, in every format; restricted amounts are excluded; parameters and classification are printed in the file.
Negative variant: Set a parameter naming another entity's project: refused or empty, never its rows.

Title: AHDA's update requests reach the entity; contributors answer and AHDA reviews
Procedure: As AHDA's Project Manager of UAT-FX-05 issue an update request to entity A naming the entity contributor. As the contributor answer and submit it. As AHDA review and accept it, then apply it.
Expected outcome: The answer is staged on acceptance and changes the source only on AHDA's explicit application; the entity sees its answer as accepted.
Negative variant: The entity contributor tries a Project Manager-only write on UAT-FX-07: refused. The entity Project Manager tries to issue an update request: refused (AHDA-only).

Title: AHDA keeps the suspension and closure decisions on an entity-managed project
Procedure: On UAT-FX-07 look for the suspension and closure commands and decisions as the entity Project Manager. As AHDA initiate and decide per WF-09 and WF-10.
Expected outcome: Every suspension, resumption, completion and closure decision is AHDA's; the entity Project Manager may only act where the source names a Project Manager step.
Negative variant: The entity Project Manager sends a suspension or closure decision directly: refused, the project's state unchanged.
Automated evidence: participation/adr-013-entity-project-manager.spec.ts (AHDA-only commands step); no WF-09/WF-10 entity automation

Title: Another entity's Project Manager reaches nothing of the project
Procedure: As entity B's Project Manager search the register for UAT-FX-07, open its direct links (overview, schedule, tasks, risks, documents) and its records, and try the writes UAT-A13-06 and UAT-A13-07 made.
Expected outcome: Nothing is listed or counted; every link shows not-found as for a project that does not exist; every write is refused without effect.
Negative variant: Control: entity A's Project Manager reads all of them.

Title: An ended Project Manager assignment ends the entity user's access
Procedure: As the access administrator end the entity Project Manager's assignment on UAT-FX-07. As the entity Project Manager retry an open page's command, a direct link, a document download and an export.
Expected outcome: Each is denied at once; the project no longer appears in their register.
Negative variant: A replayed revocation is refused and changes nothing.
